primary.title: EPFO: Employee Pension Scheme benefits, EPS payout calculation, rules, features and key FAQs, explained
primary.summary: The EPFO offers pension benefits to employees with over 10 years of service in the EPF scheme, following the EPS 1995 guidelines. Members can withdraw their PF amount at retirement and opt for various pension schemes depending on their circumstances.
